name: A Donation of Wool
summary: A Darkspear troll is gathering wool donations. Your sixty pieces of Wool Cloth will help complete the collection with support from others.

sections.title: A Shared Collection
sections.body: The Darkspear trolls are collecting Wool Cloth, and the collector can accept your sixty pieces now. Their stores need that amount from you; help from others is expected to complete the collection.

faq.answer: The Darkspear trolls are collecting Wool Cloth.

faq.q: How much Wool Cloth do they need from me?
faq.answer: The collector asks for sixty pieces of Wool Cloth from you.

faq.q: Why are the trolls collecting wool?
faq.answer: The collection is meant to replenish their stores.

faq.q: Can I give the cloth now?
faq.answer: The collector can accept your sixty pieces of Wool Cloth now.
